title: Brazil ordinance 551GC3 on reporting UFOs

tellings.quote: Uh, as of 2009, there was an ordinance called uh uh 551GC3 and it basically any military branch that sees a UFO, they are mandated to give that information to the Central Aerospace Defense Command.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that since 2009 Brazil has had a military rule, an ordinance numbered 551GC3, about UFOs, meaning unidentified flying objects. According to Michels, it requires any branch of the Brazilian military that sees one to hand the information to the Central Aerospace Defense Command, the body that watches over Brazil's skies. If so, it would mean Brazil's armed forces collect these reports as a matter of official duty.
